links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT treatment recommendations across two sessions on identical cases
links.effect: ChatGPT agreed with itself in 70.0% of cases across 2 sessions. Its inconsistent responses led the authors to judge it not reliable for therapy planning.
links.quote: The agreement between the ChatGPT responses in the 2 sessions was 70.0%.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing ChatGPT 3.5's treatment planning recommendations on 40 simulated/fictional patient cases compared against orthopaedic surgeons, but without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
